tools.name: zernio_overview
tools.description: Show an overview of what this Zernio MCP server can do (accounts, posts, analytics, ads, inbox) and how to find the right tool.

tools.name: accounts_list
tools.description:
List all connected social media accounts.

Returns the platform, username, and account ID for each connected account.
Use this to find account IDs needed for creating posts.

tools.name: accounts_get
tools.description:
Get account details for a specific platform.

Returns username and ID for the first account matching the platform.

tools.name: profiles_list
tools.description:
List all profiles.

Profiles group multiple social accounts together for easier management.

tools.name: profiles_get
tools.description: Get details of a specific profile including name, description, and color.

tools.name: profiles_create
tools.description: Create a new profile for grouping social accounts.

tools.name: profiles_update
tools.description: Update an existing profile. Only provided fields will be changed.

tools.name: profiles_delete
tools.description: Delete a profile. The profile must have no connected accounts.

tools.name: posts_list
tools.description:
List posts with optional filtering by status.

Status options: draft, scheduled, published, failed

tools.name: posts_get
tools.description: Get full details of a specific post including content, status, and scheduling info.

tools.name: posts_update
tools.description:
Update an existing post.

Only draft, scheduled, and failed posts can be updated.
Published posts cannot be modified.

tools.name: posts_delete
tools.description:
Delete a post by ID.

Published posts cannot be deleted.

tools.name: posts_retry
tools.description: Retry publishing a failed post. Only works on posts with 'failed' status.

tools.name: posts_list_failed
tools.description: List all failed posts that can be retried.

tools.name: posts_retry_all_failed
tools.description: Retry all failed posts at once.

tools.name: media_check_upload_status
tools.description:
Check the status of an upload token and get uploaded file URLs.

Use this after the user has uploaded files through the browser upload page.
Returns: pending (waiting for upload), completed (files ready), or expired (token expired).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: accounts_list, posts_list, posts_get, posts_cross_post, posts_list_failed, media_generate_upload_link, media_check_upload_status, analytics_get_analytics, analytics_get_daily_metrics, analytics_get_best_time_to_post, analytics_get_post_timeline, comments_list_inbox_comments, comments_get_inbox_post_comments, mentions_list_inbox_mentions · Private data: media_generate_upload_link, media_check_upload_status · Public sink: posts_get, posts_create, posts_publish_now, posts_cross_post, posts_update, posts_delete, posts_retry, media_generate_upload_link, media_check_upload_status, analytics_get_analytics, analytics_get_daily_metrics, analytics_get_best_time_to_post, analytics_get_post_timeline, comments_get_inbox_post_comments, comments_reply_to_inbox_post, posts_bulk_upload_posts, posts_unpublish_post, posts_edit_post, usage_get_usage, validate_post_length, validate_post · Destructive: profiles_delete, posts_delete, queue_delete_queue_slot, search_tools, call_tool.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: accounts_list, posts_list, posts_get, posts_cross_post, posts_list_failed, media_generate_upload_link, media_check_upload_status, analytics_get_analytics, analytics_get_daily_metrics, analytics_get_best_time_to_post, analytics_get_post_timeline, comments_list_inbox_comments, comments_get_inbox_post_comments, mentions_list_inbox_mentions · Private data: media_generate_upload_link, media_check_upload_status · Public sink: posts_get, posts_create, posts_publish_now, posts_cross_post, posts_update, posts_delete, posts_retry, media_generate_upload_link, media_check_upload_status, analytics_get_analytics, analytics_get_daily_metrics, analytics_get_best_time_to_post, analytics_get_post_timeline, comments_get_inbox_post_comments, comments_reply_to_inbox_post, posts_bulk_upload_posts, posts_unpublish_post, posts_edit_post, usage_get_usage, validate_post_length, validate_post · Destructive: profiles_delete, posts_delete, queue_delete_queue_slot, search_tools, call_tool

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
